page.layout: One printed page of verse, centred in the text block; a narrow strip of printed margin notes at the right edge of the scan (cut off, partly unreadable) is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Accipe & hoc ergo Lector studiose uolumen,
Scriptoriq; pijs fausta precare sonis.
Ingenium natura dedit, labor improbus artem,
Doctorumq; fides, Manle diserte, tibi.
Fata uiros audire tibi tribuere benigna,
Queis maius norunt secula nostra nihil.
Doctrinis in te pietas sanctissima certat,
O' uir doctrinas nate iuuare bonas.
main_text.head: Aliud carmen boni cuiusdam uiri, in laborem Ioannis Manlij.
main_text.p:
Præmia uirtutis, scelerum & tormenta, uenustis
Historiæ præbent conspicienda typis.
Corripiunt pœnis reprobos, summumq; timere
Erudiunt uera cum pietate Deum.
Mercedem sperare pios, & conscia recti
Corda iubent, aura nec trepidare leui.
Quod fuerat uitijs durum, fit mobile pectus:
Conuersumq; cupit iam meliora sequi.
Quandoquidem superos metuit, tædetq; pigetq;
Iam scelerum, cœli iam meditatur iter.
Exemplis igitur quisquis non flectitur istis,
Durius Hyrcana tigride pectus habet.
Post sapiet serus, uerùm spe elufus inani:
Et cùm nil metuet, pœna sequetur atrox.
Vtere mortalis uitæ pictoribus istis,
Qui uelut in speculo pulchra sequenda monet.

page.notes: Right-hand margin of the scan shows cropped, illegible fragments of printed side notes belonging to the facing page; not transcribed. Doubtful: "Quandoquidem" (line with "Quandoquidem") and "Quod"/"Quandoquidem" initial capitals are large decorated initials; "O' uir" as printed.
